# Test data

Everything here is generated by the Go reference implementation
(`cd go && go run ./internal/gentestdata -root ..`) and checked by
`go test` and the Python tests.

- `vectors.json`: canonicalisation and hashing vectors. Each entry has the
  record, the expected payload JCS, `content_hash`, core JCS and
  `chain_hash`, and whether a verifier must accept it. Implementations must
  reproduce all expected values byte for byte.
- `streams/`: JSON Lines journals with the findings a verifier must report,
  listed in `streams/expected.json` as distinct `(index, class)` pairs in
  order of first occurrence.
- `keys/`: the signing key used by the signed vectors and fixtures.

## The test key

`keys/test-ed25519.seed` and `keys/test-ed25519.pub` are **test material
only**. They are test vector 1 of RFC 8032, section 7.1, and therefore
public knowledge. Anyone can produce signatures with this key; it proves
nothing outside this test suite. Never sign real evidence with it.
